A '''Sphinx''' is a [[Mythological Creature]] that can be spawned from [[Griffin Burrows]] during the [[Mythological Ritual]].

== Spawning ==
A '''Sphinx''' has a chance to spawn when digging [[Griffin Burrows]] with a {{Legendary}} or higher {{Item|Griffin Pet}} equipped.

== Behavior ==
When spawned, the '''Sphinx''' will ask the player a question in chat. Answering correctly rewards the player with a random piece of [[Griffin_Burrows#Item_Loot|treasure]]. Answering incorrectly results in the '''Sphinx''' becoming {{Red|infuriated}}, increasing its {{Stat|Health}} and {{Stat|Max HP}} by {{Green|50%}}, as well as inflicting a stronger bleeding effect on players.

== Trivia ==
* The '''Sphinx''' is based on the Sphinx of Greek mythology, a creature that guarded the city of Thebes and killed travelers who could not answer its riddle. This is reflected in-game by the '''Sphinx''' quizzing the player on their SkyBlock knowledge.
